title: GEC Marconi scientist deaths during Star Wars/SDI era

tellings.quote: Between 1982 and 1990, 25 engineers and computer scientists, all working for GEC Maronei on some of Britain's most classified defense projects, all died one after [music] another.

plain: Between 1982 and 1990, 25 engineers and computer scientists working for GEC Marconi, a British defence electronics company, died one after another, all of them on some of Britain's most secret defence projects. These were the years of the American missile-defence plan nicknamed Star Wars. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as part of an episode about scientists going missing, where a run of deaths like this would suggest a pattern rather than chance.
